verdict.rationale: Raygun is a SaaS monitoring platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question. The probe finds an official MCP server documented in the vendor's MindscapeHQ GitHub organization, which lets an agent connect to Raygun data. The evidence is a single probe pointer with no detail on what the server covers. Missing for 10: documented tool/resource coverage, setup and auth details for connecting an agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.
